headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2024: the AEW International Title found a new home as Will Ospreay vs. Roderick Strong battled it out, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 8.02 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle ? ending the champion's reign at 2 defenses. Ospreay survived a grueling battle with Strong and The Kingdom's numbers game to win the AEW International Championship, his first singles title since arriving in AEW.
On this day in 2023, Bill & Moriarty vs. Best Friends closed out Rampage, rated 5.22 in a hard-hitting tag team clash.

That Sunday in 2024, a new champion was crowned for the AEW TBS Title as Mercedes Mone vs. Willow Nightingale battled it out, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 8.03 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle ? ending the champion's reign at 2 defenses. For Mercedes Mone, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Making her AEW in-ring debut, Mon? hit the Mon? Maker to dethrone Nightingale and win the TBS Championship, immediately drawing the ire of Stokely Hathaway.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2024, Young Bucks & Okada vs. FTR & Danielson vs. The Young Bucks vs. FTR vs. Matthew Jackson vs. Nicholas Jackson vs. Kazuchika Okada vs. Jack Perry vs. Cash Wheeler vs. Dax Harwood vs. Bryan Danielson vs. Darby Allin settled things in an Anarchy in the Arena match, closing out the card as the main event on Double or Nothing, rated 8.31 ? a genuinely great match ? part of that year's Double or Nothing '24. Jack Perry's interference helped The Elite overcome Team AEW in the chaotic Anarchy in the Arena brawl, the fight spilling out of the ring and through the crowd before Perry's low blow turned the tide for good.

Looking back to 2024, when Adam Copeland vs. Malakai Black clashed for the AEW TNT Title in a Barbed Wire Steel Cage match, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 7.40 ? a strong outing. It was the 90th time the AEW TNT Title had been on the line, a genuinely rare milestone for that title. In a bloody Barbed Wire Steel Cage match, a returning Gangrel helped fight off House of Black's interference, letting Copeland choke out Malakai Black with barbed wire to retain the TNT Title.

On this day in 2024, the AEW World Heavyweight Title was up for grabs as Swerve Strickland vs. Christian Cage went to war, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 7.51 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
